subject: Add size_t cast in modules (#2115)
reason: The change only adds (size_t) casts to the vector-length argument of ValkeyModule_Call in the test modules under tests/modules/ (aclcheck, blockedclient, commandfilter, misc, usercall). module.c reads that variadic argument as size_t ('v' format in moduleCreateArgvFromUserFormat), so the casts merely fix the variadic type mismatch; the values passed are always small non-negative counts and are bit-identical as int or size_t on all supported ABIs.
